description: Largest Helvetica size, on a fixed step, at which one line still fits a width. Sizes run from minSize to maxSize in steps (defaults 6, 72 and 0.5 points). Empty text fits at maxSize. If the line does not fit at minSize, the call is rejected. Width uses the same AFM rounding as text-width, so the size is not a float division of the two widths. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/text-fit
name: text_fit
title: Text Fit
